Hishi Miracle was a totally "avera~ge" 
Umamusume. Her motivation was just 
ordinary, and she had none of the fierce 
drive to achieve greatness seen in other 
star Umamusume.

Even in academy races, she suffered 9 
consecutive defeats... Yet, she secretly 
possessed the talent to go toe-to-toe with 
powerful, already-debuted rivals like 
Narita Top Road.

Even when it comes to the daily training 
vital for athletes, she can't do it 
properly unless you constantly push and 
nudge her, but...

All or nothing. The challenge to see if 
they could survive in the world of 
professional sports had begun.
